key_finding: On the Camelyon17 OOD natural-camera panel (72 conditions, 41/72=56.9% helpful), KGA issued 31 ADAPT decisions (43.1% of conditions) with false-adapt rate 0.000 and mean oracle regret 0.0018 vs always-adapt 0.0393 and always-freeze 0.0438. This demonstrates selective opportunistic routing — KGA adapts on beneficial conditions and protects on harmful ones — on real natural-camera OOD data.
